channel.title: Quant Arena
channel.description: Weekly arena reports, research articles and site updates.

item.title: Shareable portfolios and quick links to new tools
item.description: Portfolio weights in the compare view now live in the link, so a mix of strategies can be bookmarked or shared with one click. The home page links straight to the Strategy Lab, today's signals, the heatmap, weekly reports and the glossary.

item.title: Strategy Lab: compare your own backtest
item.description: Upload an equity curve (CSV) or a MetaTrader strategy tester report and see where it ranks against every arena strategy on the same market and the same trading days. Everything is computed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Crisis tests, luck-adjusted Sharpe and embeddable badges
item.description: Strategy pages now show how each strategy did in the Q4 2018 sell-off, the COVID crash and the 2022 bear market, its returns above and below the 200-day average, CAGR after 10 bp trading costs, and the Deflated Sharpe Ratio, which corrects for testing many strategies at once. Each strategy also has a live Arena Score badge you can embed.

item.title: Chinese strategy pages and share images
item.description: All 72 strategy pages and the category pages now have Chinese versions, and every strategy has a share image with its equity curve and key numbers for social media previews.

item.title: Today's signals, strategy heatmap, weekly reports and RSS
item.description: New pages show the current position of every strategy on every market, an Arena Score heatmap of strategies × markets, and an automatic weekly report (market moves, signal changes, best and worst strategies). Follow along with the RSS feed at /feed.xml (Chinese: /zh/feed.xml).

item.title: Arena Score v2 and 20 new metrics
item.description: The Arena Score now ranks each strategy against the others on the same market and window across five components (return quality, drawdown control, consistency, robustness, significance), so the leaderboard no longer has blocks of ties at 100 or 0, and strategies that were almost never in the market are not ranked. Strategy pages add time in market, Ulcer index, longest drawdown, VaR/CVaR, alpha, beta, capture ratios and the probabilistic Sharpe ratio, with five new glossary entries.

item.title: Every strategy, article and EA now has its own page
item.description: 72 strategy pages with equity curves, results on every market and a buy-and-hold comparison; strategy category hubs; research articles in English and Chinese; a 12-term metrics glossary with live examples; and 1,515 EA pages in both languages. Pages load fast and can be found by search engines.

item.title: EA rankings now only use reliable backtests
item.description: Sharpe ratios are recomputed from each equity curve (the old values used yearly returns and were often meaningless). Results with no trades, run errors or flat curves are labelled and left out of the ranking, and detail pages say why.

item.title: Site-wide search and recently viewed
item.description: Press / or Ctrl/Cmd+K anywhere to search strategies, EAs, research notes and pages. The home page now remembers what you opened recently (stored only in your browser).

item.title: Redesigned header, home page and footer
item.description: A cleaner navigation with a More menu, icon theme and language toggles, a new home overview with live counts, quick-entry cards, ranked top strategies, a timeline changelog, back-to-top button and a reading progress bar on articles.

item.title: Faster loading and real backtest data restored
item.description: Equity curves are now split per instrument and loaded on demand, and EA analysis data only loads on EA pages, cutting the initial download from tens of MB to about 3 MB. The last complete backtest snapshot (2026-08-17) is back in place of placeholder figures, and pages show the data date clearly.

item.title: Quant Arena Weekly Report: week 2026-W33 (2026-08-10 – 2026-08-14)
item.description: What moved in the arena during the week ending 2026-08-14: market moves, strategies that changed position, and the best and worst performers over the last month.

item.title: Backtest Pipeline Complete: 560 Strategies Tested
item.description: All 560 auto-convertible EA strategies have been backtested on EURUSD H1 data (730 days) using backtrader. Results include total trades, win rate, P&L, max drawdown, and equity curves for each EA.

item.title: Equity Curve Visualization
item.description: EA detail pages now display an equity curve chart rendered with Canvas API. Charts show ~200 downsampled points with gradient fill and theme-aware styling.

item.title: Markdown Rendering for EA Analysis
item.description: EA analysis and description fields now render Markdown syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, bold/italic) using marked.js v15.0.12. Both Chinese and English views support full Markdown.

item.title: Backtest Result Auto-Sync
item.description: Added sync_backtest_to_site.py to automate the full cycle: generate strategy → run backtest → update index → publish site → push to repo.

item.title: Keltner Channel Breakout vs Bollinger Band Reversion
item.description: Comparing two classic volatility envelopes. One rides trends using ATR, the other fades extremes using standard deviation. When to use which?

item.title: Donchian Channel and Turtle Breakout: Trading the 20/10 Rule
item.description: The Turtle system uses Donchian breakouts and risk based sizing to capture sustained trends. This research note explains the logic, market fit, and failure modes.

item.title: Supertrend and ATR Trailing Stop: Volatility Adjusted Trend Control
item.description: Supertrend uses ATR based bands to define trend flips and stops. This research note explains the signal mechanics, regime fit, and the risks of whipsaw.

item.title: Ichimoku Cloud Strategy: Regime, Momentum, and Support in One System
item.description: Ichimoku combines trend, momentum, and support into a single framework. This research note breaks down the components, signals, and common traps.

item.title: RSI Mean Reversion Strategy: Buying Weakness Inside Ranges
item.description: RSI mean reversion looks for short term exhaustion and then fades the move. This research note covers the signal logic, market fit, and risk traps.

item.title: EMA Crossover Strategy: Reading Trend With Two Clocks
item.description: An in depth look at why exponential moving average crossovers persist, how to interpret their backtests, and when trend signals fail.

item.title: Parabolic SAR Strategy: A Trend Exit Engine
item.description: Parabolic SAR uses a trailing stop that accelerates with trend strength. This article explains why it works, when it fails, and how to read its backtests.

item.title: Volatility Breakout Strategy: Trading Expansion Without Overreach
item.description: Volatility breakouts focus on price moves that escape a recent range. This guide explains the logic, the regimes where it works, and the traps to avoid.

item.title: How QuantArenas Ranks Strategies
item.description: A full methodology essay on why the Arena Score blends multiple metrics, how stability is measured, and how to read results without overfitting.
